epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce failed task revival errors to 0%
requirements: R1: Implement resumeTask(UUID) endpoint in PlannedWorkRecoveryService with CAS protection, gated by OperationalAction.REVIVE_FAILED_TASK.
R2: Expand isEligibleRetiredPlanTask to match reconcileClosedUnmergedPullRequest failures, ensuring tasks closed without merge can be recovered.

slices.title: Implement resumeTask API slice in PlannedWorkRecoveryService
slices.jtbd: When implementing the revive task API for this epic, I want to safely expand the atomic recovery mechanism, so that the missing API slice is delivered directly to main.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a closed unmerged task,
When resumeTask(UUID) is called,
Then the task is recovered using CAS protection without relying on hardcoded failure texts.
Given the need for verification,
When tests execute,
Then unit and E2E tests thoroughly verify the recovery logic and API endpoints.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Achieve 100% test coverage on resumeTask method

epics.title: Fix AutoMergeService Runtime Contract GitHub PR Reconciliation
epics.jtbd: When the orchestrator automatically merges PRs, I want the system to accurately match the PR to its task even if the session PR URL is null, so that successfully delivered work is correctly recorded as merged.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce unrecorded merged PR rate from current level to 0%
requirements: R1: Modify AutoMergeService.reconcileMergedGitHubPullRequests() to correctly match merged PRs without solely depending on an exact session.getPrUrl() match.
R2: Ensure the PR matching scanner robustly handles active projects and tasks where the PR URL was never locally populated.

slices.title: Patch AutoMergeService for robust PR reconciliation
slices.jtbd: When implementing the runtime contract fix for this epic, I want to update the PR matching logic, so that unrecorded deliveries are properly reconciled.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a merged PR with a task that has a null session PR URL,
When AutoMergeService.reconcileMergedGitHubPullRequests() runs,
Then it correctly matches the PR to the task.
Given the need for verification,
When tests execute,
Then unit and E2E tests thoroughly verify the new reconciliation behavior.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Achieve 0% silent failures during PR reconciliation

epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce uncategorized design review concern rate to 0%
epics.tocConstraintRef: Design review root cause categorization bottleneck
requirements: R1: Implement local application logic (e.g., a new Java Service and Event class) to categorize design review concerns with a rootCausePatternId.
R2: Address the 8_CONSECUTIVE_SAME_SIDE statistically confirmed pattern by properly mapping the underlying defect event to the new invariant pattern category.

slices.title: Implement local categorization service for review concerns
slices.jtbd: When implementing the root cause categorization for this epic, I want to handle pattern assignment entirely within application code, so that we avoid creating hallucinated SQL migrations for external schemas.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an uncategorized design review concern,
When the categorization logic executes,
Then it assigns the appropriate rootCausePatternId locally.
Given the need for verification,
When tests execute,
Then unit and E2E tests thoroughly verify the correct assignment of the invariant pattern.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Root cause categorization domain model constraint
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Ensure 100% of new design review concerns are categorized
